tools.name: selemene_list_engines
tools.behavior: Catalog GETs to the fixed service; no reading/profile mutation. Catalog membership remains separate from operational readiness.

tools.name: selemene_engine_info
tools.behavior: Engine metadata GET and reviewed local schema; no calculation or reading/profile mutation.

tools.name: selemene_prepare_reading
tools.behavior: Local partial-input validation; handler performs no upstream call and does not save a reading. The common edge request quota still applies.

tools.name: selemene_calculate
tools.behavior: One fixed engine calculation POST after validation and server account-phase lookup. Shared account may store inputs/results and update usage, profile, XP and access phase; persistence is not_confirmed. These are additive/initial-population operations rather than deletion.

tools.name: selemene_list_workflows
tools.behavior: Catalog and exact composition metadata GETs; no workflow execution or reading/profile mutation.

tools.name: selemene_workflow_info
tools.behavior: Exact allowlisted workflow metadata GET; no workflow execution or reading/profile mutation.

tools.name: selemene_run_workflow
tools.behavior: Checks exact reviewed composition and constituent inputs, then one workflow POST. Shared account reading/usage/profile/XP/access-phase effects are possible; persistence is not_confirmed.

tools.name: selemene_vedic_chart
tools.behavior: Fixed chart POST computes D1/D9; chart handler does not persist charts/readings or populate the user profile. Requires calculation attempt quota and internal service authentication; metrics and operational logs remain possible.

tool_annotations.common_operational_effects: Every service request can update protected edge rate-limit accounting and logs. These operational effects do not make metadata/preflight tools reading/profile writes. Chart calculations consume sponsored attempt budget although the chart handler does not save charts.
tool_annotations.open_world_basis: All handlers are limited to the fixed Selemene service origin, reviewed engine/workflow identifiers and one fixed chart path; inputs cannot choose arbitrary network destinations or external actions.
tool_annotations.destructive_basis: No exposed operation deletes user resources. Ordinary calculations/workflows append readings/usage, fill missing profile fields (COALESCE retains existing birth/location/timezone values), may replace a placeholder full_name, award XP and advance access phase. These are disclosed account updates; readOnlyHint is false for both operations.
